description: The container substrate of the Constellation family. v0.1 ships phase K0 only: a signed-image verification gate an agent (or a pipeline, or the Test Bench) calls before an image is allowed anywhere near a runtime. It resolves the image digest from its registry (read-only), verifies the cosign-style signature and DSSE/in-toto provenance against a written policy and a local trust bundle, and returns a per-check PASS/FAIL verdict — registry allowlisted, signature valid, signer named by policy, payload bound to this digest, provenance present and of the required type. Fail-closed on every error, and every verdict lands in a hash-chained receipt ledger. Pure Python stdlib cryptography (ECDSA P-256, Ed25519, RSA); no container runtime required.
